Resolves #22104
Related: #21198, #21603

A theme change in detached Settings now reaches its own window, its desktop, and the other popups attached to that desktop. A running task underlines the width of its icon and label; a minimized task keeps a centered 6 px marker.

Evidence: L3 (two independent browser documents, computed colors, actual taskbar geometry and a repeat on WebKit) → L3 required.

## AC Evidence

| Acceptance criterion | Verified observation |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | A change originating in detached Settings reaches its own viewport and the other windows of that desktop. A separately opened desktop retains its original palette. Opener-origin and nested scope changes also reach the popup. |
| AC-2 | Newly opened Documents and reloaded Mail follow the current theme. Returning an inherited body after a pre-popout theme switch preserves the current ink; a distinct body override keeps its own ink through the round trip. |
| AC-3 | The old task marker was 18 px at all widths. Mail and Messages now measure 64 and 102 px on the desktop, or 30 px on icon-only phone tasks. Both minimize to 6 px, and the 2 px keyboard focus outline stays visible. Both gallery JPEGs show the 64 px Mail mark. |


### Desktop and phone previews

| Viewport | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1440 × 900 | ![Desktop before, with short marks under Mail and Messages](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/a328a27836bd999a269718c3624e90614bcbfb5a/review-evidence/22104/before-1440x900.png?raw=true) | ![Desktop after, with each underline spanning its task](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/a328a27836bd999a269718c3624e90614bcbfb5a/review-evidence/22104/after-1440x900.png?raw=true) |
| 390 × 844 | ![Phone before, with the original 18 px task markers](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/a328a27836bd999a269718c3624e90614bcbfb5a/review-evidence/22104/before-390x844.png?raw=true) | ![Phone after, with 30 px marks beneath the task icons](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/a328a27836bd999a269718c3624e90614bcbfb5a/review-evidence/22104/after-390x844.png?raw=true) |

A production Portal Apps card repainted dark → light → dark via the header theme switch without a reload. Both 1280 × 720 images decoded and matched the card pixels. This check routed only the two pending public media URLs to their verified Pages-branch bytes.

Frame critique: the short line floated beneath the join between icon and label. The new line spans both while leaving its rounded ends inside the button. I verified the result in dark and light, with standard and reduced motion.

## Deltas from ticket

The admitted popup observes its owning dialog and its logical desktop parent, and releases both subscriptions on detach. A floating AppWindow can sit outside its parent’s items, so a change can reach the logical desktop without changing the dialog’s own theme config. The return restores a distinct body override or the current owner theme for an inherited body.

Only the two edges of the absolute, 3 px-high task marker animate. This keeps the rounded ends at 2 px and the minimized mark at 6 px for both icon-only and variable-width label buttons. The taskbar row keeps its dimensions throughout.

The Portal theme switch now selects matched Web Desktop gallery frames. Both use the same Mail scene, and both encoded JPEGs contain a 64 px marker. The curated capture includes the full viewport and taskbar. Merge [the visitor-facing media](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/208) before deploying the catalog flag. [Dark preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/f0435ae8371dc951f540e93c024d0ef04aee7c49/resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg) · [Light preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/f0435ae8371dc951f540e93c024d0ef04aee7c49/resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0-light.jpg)

## Test Evidence

- Nine tear-out units and all ten Web Desktop Apps browser cases passed with the review fixes. The new cases exercise pre-switched and nested theme scopes, a distinct body override, and taskbar indicator geometry at desktop and phone widths.
- The new two-desktop test failed on `47118ccf83`. It passed on this branch and covers source isolation, both theme directions, a popup reload, return to the original desktop, and the returned Settings content’s computed color.
- Separate Chrome and WebKit runs reproduced the original dark popup, then passed with the correction. A fresh production build (`mwtgyt9v`) rendered light Settings ink `rgba(15,23,42,.66)` in both the detached and returned views.
- Keyboard navigation and the minimized task marker were also exercised at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844.

## Commits

- `f5bccddc79` fixes detached theme propagation and taskbar indicator sizing.
- `ffbd5fab24` preserves a distinct body override and follows the effective owner scope, including a pre-popout switch. Browser regressions cover the ownership correction and the indicator widths.

- `b376ef3c3d` follows the source viewport when the standalone dialog has no explicit or inherited theme scope.
- `54156b34ec` refreshes the tracked Web Desktop catalog JPEG with the corrected running indicator.

- `1cabbdf72e` pairs the Web Desktop preview with the app’s actual light palette and retains the taskbar in future curated captures.

- `21490cf135` keeps the light gallery image in Pages, the runtime media source. The npm package guard passes without a new exception.

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:
- **Decision**: Request Changes
- **Rationale**: No §0 catalog row fires (`#22104` is live, leaf-scoped, and grounded in the 23 Nov Web Desktop manual-test findings). Two in-scope defects and one rendered-surface evidence gate belong in this PR before the v14 cut: (1) `WindowTearOut#open` + `#restorePane` still freeze `entry.bodyTheme = body.theme` at pop-out time, which stamps a stale local theme override onto `bodyContainer` (and permanently breaks future inheritance) whenever a desktop switched themes at least once before pop-out and switches again while detached, plus `#attach` observes `root` (`mainView`) instead of `owner`; (2) `TaskList.css` switches `::after` from `transform` to layout-animating `inset-inline` without `demo-surface-motion-audit.md`'s documented product rationale or any CI assertion for AC-3's desktop/phone indicator geometry; and (3) `Frame critique:` is present without the embedded whole-surface before/after pair required by `rendered-surface-audit.md` Gate 1.

**Peer-Review Opening:** Clean, surgical scoping, Emmy — keeping the desktop controller as the single theme writer while scoping the popup subscription to `WindowTearOut`'s admitted entry (`#attach` / `#unhookTarget`) avoids any global popup registry, and the two-desktop + popup-reload E2E harness is great coverage infrastructure. Three compact repairs will make both the multi-flip return lifecycle and the taskbar indicator rock-solid for the cut.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: Trace a two-step theme sequence through `WindowTearOut.mjs` (`lines 83, 315`), `container/Base.mjs#afterSetTheme` (`line 312`), and `component/Base.mjs#afterSetTheme` (`line 976`):
  1. On a running desktop, switch theme once (Dark → Light). `container.Base#afterSetTheme` propagates `item.theme = 'neo-theme-neo-light'` into `owner` (`AppWindow`) and `body` (`bodyContainer`), so `body.theme` is now `'neo-theme-neo-light'` (whereas on fresh boot in `Apps.spec.mjs`, `body.theme` was still `null`, which masked this bug!).
  2. Pop out `Settings`: `WindowTearOut#open` (`line 83`) snapshots `entry.bodyTheme = body.theme` (`'neo-theme-neo-light'`).
  3. Inside detached `Settings`, click **Dark**: `owner.theme` becomes `'neo-theme-neo-dark'`.
  4. Click **Back to desktop**: `#restorePane` (`line 315`) executes `entry.body.theme = entry.bodyTheme` (`'neo-theme-neo-light'`) while `owner.theme` is `'neo-theme-neo-dark'`. Because `value !== parent.theme`, `component.Base#afterSetTheme` stamps `.neo-theme-neo-light` directly onto `body.cls`, and `container.Base#afterSetTheme` (`!item.theme || item.theme === oldValue`) thereafter treats `body` as a custom local override — leaving `Settings` permanently stuck in Light inside the Dark window across all subsequent theme toggles!
